protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: conflux_send_switch_command() ignored both relay_send_command_from_edge() return values. That callee returns -1 after circuit_package_relay_cell() failure and marks the circuit for close; conflux_circuit_has_closed() reaches cfx_del_leg(), which removes and frees the selected leg and NULLs cfx->curr_leg. The caller then continued to write cfx->curr_leg->last_seq_sent. CVE-2026-77641 is PUBLISHED and describes this exact CWE-252 / TROVE-2026-017 mechanism.
